title: 2 July 2019: one WAF rule takes down the edge
story: At 13:42 UTC a new firewall rule deploys to every Cloudflare machine at once. Its regular expression backtracks so badly that CPU hits 100% worldwide and sites behind Cloudflare return 502 errors. This is the first page that went out, three minutes later.
basis: A replay of a real outage. The timeline, the regular expression, the SLA and the affected sites come from Cloudflare's public postmortem and press reports, each linked on its record. The code is a small Python stand-in, because the real WAF source is not public.

annotations.summary: Synthetic WAF check failing from outside the network; 502 errors and CPU exhaustion reported worldwide
